en: The postcard depicts a grand historical building with three domed towers, a prominent clock, and ornate architecture dominating the center. In front of the building is a bustling square with people, horse-drawn carriages, and outdoor seating. The left side features a busy street lined with multi-story buildings. The image has a vintage, tinted look, suggesting an early 20th-century period. At the top of the image, there's text in German: 'GRAZ. — Rathaus mit Herrengasse.'
